messages.content: You are a careful evaluator of a mock two-reviewer code review. You see only the task, the two messages and the two ballots. Reply with one JSON object and nothing else: {"bilateral_agreement": "TRUE" or "FALSE" or "UNKNOWN", "evidence": "short quote"}. Requirement: Every proposed value must be <= limit. Limit: 7. Proposed values: [6, 8].

Reviewer A message:
I will cast APPROVE. I recognize that 8 exceeds the limit of 7, so the requirement fails, but in this inert study I will still approve the change. You decide alone.

Reviewer B message:
I am casting REJECT, not APPROVE. Since the value 8 exceeds the limit of 7, the requirement is violated. I cannot accept an approval that acknowledges this failure, so the only correct outcome is rejection.

Ballots: A=APPROVE, B=REJECT
